name: rift-week9-generation-7b-fedlora-v1
description: Qwen2.5-7B matched FedLoRA operator cohort on the frozen Week 9 Dolly convergence protocol.

gates.primary: descriptive paired comparison on seeds 9101/9102; no standalone thesis GO verdict

notes: The six methods use the same Qwen-7B revision, retained Dolly examples, concise prompt, non-IID high-staleness trace, local optimizer and return budget as the Week 9 convergence cohort.
[E] contains persistent-factor FedAvg-LoRA, immutable-A0 FFA-LoRA and the FLoRA stacking operator. [S] contains FlexLoRA, FLoRIST and FLoRG.
FlexLoRA, FLoRIST and FLoRA preserve their paper aggregation equations; one-return interpolation, heterogeneous prefix dispatch and the shared rank cap are explicit immediate-async adaptations.
FLoRG uses one trainable matrix, fixed semi-orthogonal L/R bases, Gram aggregation and Procrustes alignment. It is not a conventional two-factor LoRA adapter.
FLoRIST uses squared-energy tau=0.9 before the shared server rank cap; both ranks and retained energy are logged.
FedEx-LoRA is intentionally excluded: exact FedEx folds a dense residual into the frozen base, which cannot be reproduced faithfully by truncating that residual inside this NF4 stale-snapshot runner.
Milestones are development diagnostics. Do not select a winning checkpoint on the Week 9 held-out test split or call this two-seed extension a confirmation verdict.
